RAHUL PIMOLI
Creative Lead | Multimedia Designer | Video Editor & Motion Graphics | Content Specialist 

Gurugram, India  |  +91-9289887978  |  Paulrahul396@gmail.com 
linkedin.com/in/rahul-pimoli-971a73167 

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 

Multimedia Designer with 5 years of experience in video editing, motion graphics, graphic design, and social 
media strategy. Proven track record delivering high-impact content for sports, luxury, and lifestyle brands. Skilled 
in LED broadcast graphics, highlight reel production, UGC content, and social media management. Experienced 
team leader who has trained 10+ employees and managed a 10-member creative team. Adept at translating 
market trends into compelling visual content with measurable results. 

WORK EXPERIENCE 

Creative Media Associate  |  Stupa Sports Analytics 
April 2024 - Present  |  Gurugram, Haryana, India | On-site 

- Led creative production across Marketing, Media, Founders, and Broadcast teams. 
- Designed LED broadcast graphics for Ultimate Table Tennis (UTT) including player entries, team vs team, 

and champion showcase sequences during live events. 
- Developed complete visual branding for Shriram Table Tennis Smash 2026. 
- Produced highlight reels for World Table Tennis, ITTF, and European Badminton events, increasing online 

engagement. 
- Managed live social media for ETTU during international events, creating real-time reels and driving 

audience engagement. 
- Created investor pitch videos and software demo videos for the Founders team. 
- Trained 10+ employees in Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Final Cut Pro; led a 10-member media 

team. 

Senior Video Editor and Graphic Designer  |  Sumvaik Consulting Group 
December 2023 - March 2024  |  Gurugram, Haryana, India | On-site 

- Managed video editing and graphic design deliverables for 12+ clients simultaneously. 
- Produced 50+ UGC videos that improved engagement and follower growth across client social channels. 
- Created social media content calendars, carousel advertisements, and trend-based content strategies. 
- Conducted ongoing market and social media trend research to keep client campaigns current and 

competitive. 

Creative Head  |  Tushar Batra Films and Photos 
March 2022 - June 2023  |  Gurugram, Haryana, India | On-site 

- Promoted from Video Editor to Creative Head within 14 months based on creative performance and 
leadership. 

- Oversaw full creative pipeline including shoot planning, content ideation, post-production, and final delivery. 
- Produced viral social media reels and brand films achieving 242K max Instagram views and 500K YouTube 

views. 
- Secured high-profile luxury clients through the quality and reach of produced content. 
- Mentored junior editors and established quality and efficiency standards for the creative team. 

Video Editor  |  Tushar Batra Films and Photos 
January 2021 - March 2022  |  Gurugram, Haryana, India | On-site 

- Edited 50+ luxury wedding and commercial films ranging from 1-minute highlight reels to 50-minute long-
form features. 

- Managed full post-production workflow including colour grading, audio mixing, motion graphics, and export. 
- Researched video trends and competitor content to continuously improve creative output. 

rahulpimoli.com | behance.net/rahulpimoli | linkedin.com/in/rahul-pimoli-971a73167



Graphic Designer  |  ABP News 
October 2020 - December 2020  |  India | Remote 

- Designed 10+ YouTube thumbnails daily for multiple regional news channels across Hindi, English, and 
Punjabi language audiences. 

- Optimised thumbnail design for click-through rate across multi-language digital news properties. 

FREELANCE EXPERIENCE 

- Devasyah Studios (Luxury Production) - Edited reels for weddings, fashion shoots, and corporate brand 
campaigns. 

- Hydrama, Levernashia, and hospitality brands - Created short-form social media content for restaurants, 
clubs, and corporate clients. 

- Joypur Calling and Manali Manor Hotel - Built and managed Instagram accounts, creating consistent visual 
identity from the ground up. 

- Kanchan Rawat (Travel Content Creator, 5K followers) - Managed full content pipeline from ideation to 
posting; achieved 3 million+ views on a single reel. 

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS 

Bachelor of Science in Animation  |  Graphic Era Hill University 
April 2018 - July 2021 

Digital Marketing Certificate  |  Google 
Issued June 2023 

SKILLS 

Video Editing and Post-Production 
Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Video Colour Grading, Audio Mixing, Motion 
Graphics, Long-form Editing, Short-form Editing, Reel Editing, UGC Video Production, Highlight Reel Production, 
Broadcast Graphics, LED Graphic Design 
Graphic Design 
Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Lightroom, Canva, Thumbnail Design, Social Media Graphics, 
Carousel Design, Brand Identity, Visual Branding 
Social Media and Content Strategy 
Instagram Strategy, Content Planning, Social Media Management, Content Calendar Creation, Trend Analysis, 
Audience Engagement, Real-time Social Media, Campaign Execution 
AI Creative Tools 
Higgsfield, VEO 3, ChatGPT, Magnific, Seedance, Nano Banana, Flow, Gemini, Claude, AI Video Generation, AI 
Image Generation 
Leadership and Management 
Team Leadership, Creative Direction, Project Management, Client Management, Training and Mentoring, End-to-
End Production Management, Cross-functional Collaboration
